extName.message: Full Page PDF Snap – Save Webpage as PDF

extDescription.message: Save any webpage as a single high-resolution PDF. Auto-scrolls the whole page — no cropping, no print dialog.

actionTitle.message: Full Page PDF Snap — save the whole page as PDF

commandCapture.message: Save the whole page as PDF

popupHeading.message: Save the whole page as PDF

internalPage.message: Internal browser page (settings, store, add-on pages) — please switch to a normal website (https://…).

protectedPage.message: The browser protects this page. Please switch to a normal website (e.g. wikipedia.org).

noScripts.message: This page does not allow extension scripts.

incompleteHint.message: Parts of the page could not be captured completely:

endlessScrollHint.message: The page keeps loading more content as it scrolls. Captured what was there at the start — the PDF is shorter than the page is now.

menuCapture.message: Save the whole page as PDF

menuSaveAs.message: Ask where to save every time

optIntro.message: Save the whole page as a high-resolution PDF via auto-scroll.

optSaveAs.message: Ask where to save every time

optSinglePage.message: One continuous page (default — no visible seams)

optLayoutContext.message: Menu once at the top, content below (default)

optAfterBoth.message: Show folder and open the PDF

optScaleHint.message: 1.0x shows the page as on screen. Higher is sharper but fits less into the window.

optLanguageHint.message: Interface language. "Automatic" follows the browser language, otherwise English. The name shown in the store always follows the browser language — an extension cannot influence that.

optSubfolderHint.message: Leave empty to save straight into Downloads/. Only subfolders are possible.

optShortcutNone.message: none assigned — conflicts with a browser shortcut

optShortcutHint.message: To change it, open the address next to the button.

optShortcutCopied.message: Address copied — paste it into a new tab

optShortcutWhere.message: To change it, open this address in a new tab:

resultTitle.message: Capture ready — Full Page PDF Snap

resultNoPreview.message: The preview cannot be shown here.

resultShareHint.message: This browser cannot pass files to other apps directly. The PDF opens in the app chooser — share it from there.

resultShareViaDownload.message: This browser cannot hand files to other apps directly. The PDF has been saved — open it from your downloads and share it from there.
resultShareViaDownload.description: Shown when the browser cannot share files; the PDF was downloaded instead.

resultGone.message: No capture available. Start a new one from the extension icon.

popupHideOff.message: Banners will be captured as they are

regionHint.message: Drag to select an area · Esc cancels

optCopyPath.message: Copy the file path to the clipboard after saving

popupCopyOn.message: Path will be copied after saving

optFetchOriginal.message: Also download the publisher's original file

optFetchOriginalHint.message: Fetches the full-text address the page declares itself.

androidFertig.message: PDF ready — open it to view or download

androidGespeichert.description: Android: the PDF was downloaded; $DATEI$ is the filename.

androidDownloadFehler.message: The PDF could not be saved.
androidDownloadFehler.description: Android: the download could not be started; the reason is appended.

fehlerAllgemein.message: The capture could not be completed. Please try again.

optBildSw.message: Black and white — smallest, for text pages

optBildModusHint.message: Greyscale and black and white make much smaller files at the same text recognition — but black and white loses photographs.

optVektor.message: Capture the page as text, not as an image

optVektorHint.message: The browser typesets the PDF itself: selectable text, working links, one pass, much smaller files. Asks for one permission.

optVektorSeite.message: The whole page, as it looks on screen (default)

optVektorArtikel.message: The article only — without navigation and sidebars

optVektorModusHint.message: If no article can be identified, the whole page is captured.

optSettlingHint.message: Raise it on pages that load slowly.

optFooter.message: Visible provenance line under the capture

optFooterHint.message: Changes the image. The details are in the PDF properties anyway.

optTriggerMenu.message: Right-click on the page → the extension's entry

optImmerImPdf.message: Searchable text layer and time anchor — always. The citation whenever “Add citation details” is switched on: inside the PDF (document properties, attached RIS record) and as a text file next to the PDF in the same folder. A short tone when it is done.

optJpegHint.message: 0.92 is the default. Higher means a bigger file, lower means visible artefacts in colour gradients.

artikelNichtGefunden.message: No article found on this page. Use "Capture whole page" instead.

artikelNichtMoeglich.message: The article could not be read on this page.

optVektorAbgelehnt.message: Permission declined — the image path stays in use.

popupArtikelText.message: As a text file instead of PDF

beilagenImPdf.message: Citation saved inside the PDF (RIS attachment + document properties).

popupHideOverlaysTitel.message: Consent dialogs and floating bars are hidden for the capture and restored afterwards.

popupCiteTitel.message: Author, DOI, licence and retrieval time go into the PDF itself and into a text file beside it, in the same folder. AI tools can read them there.

popupCopyPathTitel.message: Once finished, paste the path with Ctrl+V into a terminal or a chat.

optBeilagenText.message: Only when “Add citation details” is switched on in the menu. Both land in the same folder as the PDF.

optZitatDatei.message: Citation as a text file (.zitate.txt) — to read and copy

optRisDatei.message: File for reference managers (.ris) — Citavi, Zotero, EndNote
